commentary_title: Tonnage oversupply in the Med hurts Aframax rates
commentary_summary: The Aframax tonne-miles index ended the week at 105.1 points down by close to 15 points. It was a mixed week for the Aframax market towards the West, with rates firming up in the UKC. Towards the Med, however, the previous week's enthusiasm weakened due to tonnage supply being too high. Many vessels had ballasted away from the UKC likely to get a share of the Mediterranean market. | Towards the Far East, freight rates remained firm, with few changes in the market. There was a big reduction in the number of vessels in the ports on an MoM basis in the East. There was an overall decline in the tonnage underway in the East and the West which leaves much potential for trade to pick up next week.
